limitations: Metadata inventory, not 1524 quantitative series
Publication DOI cells are retained as archived; not all original articles independently checked
Record Density intervals are coverage statements, not harmonized age models

coverage.pagination: ERDDAP server-filtered distinct response; no row limit applied
coverage.snapshot: Source ERDDAP metadata date_created 2024-11-11; legacy viewer retired in 2025
limitations: Includes adjacent Atlantic/Black Sea/Red Sea sites in the declared rectangle
Samples with same cruise/sample can be distinct devices/IGSNs; retained separately
Current physical sample availability requires curator confirmation
Exactly the named public Raw Data search result and table, not asserted complete across all WPA views
Species is preserved; no proxy variable is inferred from an undocumented query code
No numerical series ingested; native campaigns and paper relationships require further review

coverage.provider: PANGAEA via DataCite + source-native seed XML
coverage.query: geoLocations.geoLocationPoint.pointLatitude:[28 TO 48] AND geoLocations.geoLocationPoint.pointLongitude:[-10 TO 42] AND (subjects.subject:sediment* OR titles.title:core* OR subjects.subject:drilling)
limitations: Exhaustive only for this explicit DataCite query at retrieval time; not all PANGAEA sediment cores
Point filters omit records with only bounding boxes or missing georeferencing; query may match sediment datasets without cores
Separate latitude/longitude index fields can match different points; canonical points are post-filtered within bbox
DataCite points are dataset-level; not promoted to named cores or sampling events
Native event/campaign enrichment restricted explicitly to the ten existing PANGAEA seed datasets
Current source XML can contain old and new names; labels preferred and all unknown fields remain in cached originals
No measurements downloaded or parsed; publication_year here is dataset metadata year, not automatically paper year
Point locations only; site bounds are not converted to invented coordinates
NOAA archive-type filter excludes global climate reconstructions/tree rings/corals; campaigns are not inferred from studies
Neotoma includes collection units; multiple units at a site are not automatically independent locations
No observations downloaded; licenses and chronology require record-level review
Counts are source entries, not de-duplicated independent physical cores
No campaigns inferred from core prefixes
Metadata locations and reported proxy presence do not imply reviewed numeric data
Coverage is documented per query/snapshot, never universal completeness
